[SWS_DM_01475] DM shall allow only one lock per SOVD entity
⌈
DM shall
not allow a SOVD client to acquire a lock on the SOVD entity (or SOVD sub entity) if
another SOVD client has locked the same SOVD entity for accessing or operating on the
SOVD entity resource and return error code.
⌋
